description: Read production facts for a few changed files or functions from Fallow Cloud, with no full pull and no local analysis. Backed by `fallow coverage review-packet --format json`. `repo` is required; pass `files` and/or `functions` (`{file, name, line?}`), or neither to send the files changed against `base`. Rows carry `repo_path`, `tracking_state` (current deployment) and `period_tracking_state` (whole period); `evidence_window` is the real evidence span. A current `never_called` with `period_tracking_state: called` is not dead code. Needs `FALLOW_API_KEY` in the server environment; see `fallow://tools/get_cloud_review_packet`.

base.description: Base ref for the changed-file default.

max_output_bytes.description:
Byte cap for this call's response. Lowers the server cap (default
1000000); over it the call is REFUSED (`isError`, `exit_code: 2`).

root.description: Project root; defaults to the working directory.

name: get_cloud_review_packet
